strings.name: Olivier Blanchard
strings.summary: Blanchard studies fluctuations, unemployment and monetary and fiscal policy, combining scholarship, textbooks and international policy experience. He led IMF research from 2008 to 2015 before joining PIIE. His work on public debt under low interest rates and fiscal sustainability continues to inform debate. He is also an MIT professor emeritus.

strings.influence.rationale: Studies macroeconomic fluctuations and fiscal policy and formerly led research at the International Monetary Fund.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Economics DES, Paris-Nanterre (1972); MIT economics PhD (1977).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Research and teaching
strings.highlights.h1.text: Connects fluctuations, policy instruments and institutions through research and textbooks.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Crises and public debt
strings.highlights.h2.text: Examines post-crisis policy, low interest rates and multiple equilibria in debt markets.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Debt-sustainability working paper
strings.timeline.t1.text: With Huertas and Martínez-Bruera, analyzed uncertainty and sovereign-debt equilibria.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Book on low-rate fiscal policy
strings.timeline.t2.text: Fiscal Policy under Low Interest Rates examined debt, policy space and risks.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Public-debt paper published
strings.timeline.t3.text: Discussed public debt and low interest rates in the American Economic Review.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Joined PIIE
strings.timeline.t4.text: Moved to policy research after leading the IMF research department.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became IMF economic counsellor
strings.timeline.t5.text: Also directed research through the global financial crisis.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Led MIT economics department
strings.timeline.t6.text: Began a department-chair term lasting until 2003.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Graduate textbook co-authored
strings.timeline.t7.text: Published Lectures on Macroeconomics with Stanley Fischer.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Doctorate and Harvard appointment
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed MIT’s doctorate and began teaching at Harvard.
